title: Unit platform tour
description: A pinned tour on white: on the left a big three-line heading, a hairline pill and three tabs, each with a thin grey left line; on the right a wide dark panel with a coloured glow along its foot, holding a translucent settings card of ticked boxes and small switches. On desktop the stage sticks under the header for about one and a half windows while the scroll fills each tab's line top to bottom and crossfades the card to the next tab's settings. On phones the panel sits above a sideways row of tabs that advance on a five-second timer.
notes: the dark panel is a `dark` island, so it stays dark in light mode and uses each theme's dark tokens
media slot: the panel backdrop (a blurred colour image in the original); empty shows glow washes
desktop pinning is CSS sticky; tab choice and line fills follow the scroll through motion's useScroll; with reduced motion nothing pins and tabs change on click
